message.content:
Build a REPORT-A-BUG / REQUEST-A-FEATURE system (customer + admin) for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
- Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireUser, currentUser } from "@/lib/auth"`; admin gate `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` → `await requireArea("support")`. Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-primary`,`.btn-secondary`,`.btn-ghost`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- NEW model `Feedback { id, userId, user, kind("BUG"|"FEATURE"), title, body, url, status("NEW"|"PLANNED"|"IN_PROGRESS"|"DONE"|"DECLINED"), adminNote, createdAt, updatedAt }`.
- READ FIRST: `components/AdminControls.tsx` (client action-button pattern) and any existing ticket UI (`components/customer/*Ticket*` / `app/dashboard/support`) for style.

## TASK
1. **Feedback widget** `components/FeedbackWidget.tsx` (`"use client"`, default export, fully self-contained) — a small floating button labeled "Feedback" fixed bottom-right; opens a modal to **Report a bug** or **Request a feature** (kind toggle) with title + description; auto-captures the current path (`window.location.pathname`) as `url`. Submits via the `submitFeedback` action; shows a thank-you state. Works in BOTH portals (it will be mounted globally by the orchestrator — don't mount it yourself).
2. **Actions** `lib/actions-feedback.ts` (`"use server"`): `submitFeedback(kind, title, body, url)` (requireUser; validates; creates a Feedback row); `adminUpdateFeedback(id, status, adminNote)` (`requireArea("support")`); optionally `adminListFeedback(filter)`.
3. **Customer page** `app/dashboard/feedback/page.tsx` — the signed-in user's own submissions (status badges) + an inline submit form (reuse the widget's form or a simple form).
4. **Admin page** `app/admin/feedback/page.tsx` (`requireArea("support")`) — table of all feedback, filter by kind/status, per-row status dropdown + admin note, via `components/admin/FeedbackControls.tsx` (`"use client"`).

## OWNED FILES (create ONLY these)
`lib/actions-feedback.ts`, `components/FeedbackWidget.tsx`, `app/dashboard/feedback/page.tsx`, `app/admin/feedback/page.tsx`, `components/admin/FeedbackControls.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config, layouts, components/portal/Shell.tsx (orchestrator mounts the widget), lib/db.ts, lib/rbac.ts, worker/*, ROADMAP, docs/**, sitemap, or files not in your list. Do NOT run build/prisma-push/generate/restart. No commits, no new deps. `"use server"` = async-only.

## REPORT
Files created; how submit + admin triage work; INTEGRATION NEEDED (mount `<FeedbackWidget/>` in the portal Shell for both portals; nav links to `/admin/feedback` and `/dashboard/feedback`); risks.

1	import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
2	import type { Role, User } from "@prisma/client";
3	import { realUser } from "./auth";
4	
5	/**
6	 * Role-based access control for the admin ops portal.
7	 *
8	 * The admin surface is divided into logical *areas*. Each area maps to the set
9	 * of staff roles allowed to see and use it. ADMIN implicitly has every area.
10	 * The admin layout uses this to (a) let any staff role in and (b) hide nav
11	 * items a role can't reach; each sensitive page additionally gates itself with
12	 * `requireArea(...)` so a hand-typed URL is refused too.
13	 */
14	export type Area =
15	  | "overview"
16	  | "analytics"
17	  | "clients"
18	  | "support"
19	  | "fleet"
20	  | "billing"
21	  | "platform";
22	
23	/** Which roles may access each area. ADMIN is always allowed (see canAccess). */
24	export const AREA_ROLES: Record<Area, Role[]> = {
25	  overview: ["SUPPORT", "BILLING", "ADMIN"],
26	  analytics: ["ADMIN"],
27	  clients: ["SUPPORT", "ADMIN"],
28	  support: ["SUPPORT", "ADMIN"],
29	  fleet: ["ADMIN"],
30	  billing: ["BILLING", "ADMIN"],
31	  platform: ["ADMIN"],
32	};
33	
34	export function canAccess(role: Role, area: Area): boolean {
35	  return role === "ADMIN" || AREA_ROLES[area].includes(role);
36	}
37	
38	/** Any non-customer role that belongs in the ops portal. */
39	export function isStaff(role: Role): boolean {
40	  return role === "SUPPORT" || role === "BILLING" || role === "ADMIN";
41	}
42	
43	/** Maps admin nav hrefs to their governing area. Unknown routes default to platform (ADMIN-only). */
44	const HREF_AREA: Record<string, Area> = {
45	  "/admin": "overview",
46	  "/admin/analytics": "analytics",
47	  "/admin/users": "clients",
48	  "/admin/support": "support",
49	  "/admin/servers": "fleet",
50	  "/admin/nodes": "fleet",
51	  "/admin/ips": "fleet",
52	  "/admin/provisioning": "fleet",
53	  "/admin/monitoring": "fleet",
54	  "/admin/infrastructure": "fleet",
55	  "/admin/subscriptions": "billing",
56	  "/admin/billing": "billing",
57	  "/admin/invoices": "billing",
58	  "/admin/plans": "billing",
59	  "/admin/coupons": "billing",
60	  "/admin/domains": "platform",
61	  "/admin/grant": "platform",
62	  "/admin/audit": "platform",
63	  "/admin/automation": "platform",
64	  "/admin/settings": "platform",
65	  "/admin/staff": "platform",
66	  "/admin/email-templates": "platform",
67	  "/admin/games": "platform",
68	  "/admin/blog": "platform",
69	};
70	
71	export function areaForHref(href: string): Area {
72	  return HREF_AREA[href] ?? "platform";
73	}
74	
75	export function canAccessHref(role: Role, href: string): boolean {
76	  return canAccess(role, areaForHref(href));
77	}
78	
79	/**
80	 * Server-side page guard. Redirects to /login if signed out, or back to the
81	 * overview if the (staff) user's role can't reach this area. Returns the real
82	 * signed-in user (impersonation is refused elsewhere in the admin layout).
83	 */
84	export async function requireArea(area: Area): Promise<User> {
85	  const user = await realUser();
86	  if (!user) redirect("/login");
87	  if (!isStaff(user.role)) redirect("/dashboard");
88	  if (!canAccess(user.role, area)) redirect("/admin");
89	  return user;
90	}

## Report

Built the full report-a-bug / request-a-feature system for Nxeon. All 5 owned files created; `tsc --noEmit` passes with 0 errors and the generated Prisma client already has the `Feedback` model.

### Files created
- **`lib/actions-feedback.ts`** (`"use server"`) — `submitFeedback(kind, title, body, url)` (requireUser, Zod-validated, creates a `Feedback` row, notifies admins); `adminUpdateFeedback(id, status, adminNote)` (`requireArea("support")`, updates status/note, notifies the reporter on status change); `adminListFeedback(filter)` helper.
- **`components/FeedbackWidget.tsx`** (`"use client"`, default export) — floating bottom-right "Feedback" button → modal with bug/feature toggle, title + description, auto-captures `window.location.pathname` as `url`, submits via the action, shows a thank-you state. Also exports a named `FeedbackForm` (shared by the customer page).
- **`app/dashboard/feedback/page.tsx`** — the signed-in user's own submissions with status badges + admin-reply note, plus an inline `FeedbackForm` in a side card.
- **`app/admin/feedback/page.tsx`** (`requireArea("support")`) — full table with kind/status filter pills (via searchParams), an "N open" counter, per-row triage via `FeedbackControls`.
- **`components/admin/FeedbackControls.tsx`** (`"use client"`) — `FeedbackRowControls`: status dropdown + internal note textarea that save together via `adminUpdateFeedback`, with dirty-tracking and Saved/error feedback.

### How it works
- **Submit:** widget or dashboard form → `submitFeedback` → validates, writes `Feedback` (status `NEW`), fires a notification to every ADMIN linking `/admin/feedback`.
- **Triage:** admin picks a status (NEW → PLANNED → IN_PROGRESS → DONE/DECLINED) and optionally writes an admin note; saving updates the row and, on status change, notifies the reporter (linking `/dashboard/feedback`). The admin note is surfaced back to the customer as "Reply from team".

### INTEGRATION NEEDED (orchestrator)
1. Mount `<FeedbackWidget />` globally in `components/portal/Shell.tsx` (imported from `@/components/FeedbackWidget`) so it renders in both the customer and admin portals — I did not touch Shell per the hard rules.
2. Add nav links: `/dashboard/feedback` (customer sidebar) and `/admin/feedback` (admin sidebar, support area). Note: `HREF_AREA` in `lib/rbac.ts` has no entry for `/admin/feedback`, so it defaults to `platform` (ADMIN-only) for nav visibility — the page itself gates on `requireArea("support")`. If SUPPORT staff should see the nav link, add `"/admin/feedback": "support"` to `HREF_AREA` (rbac.ts is not mine to edit).

### Risks / notes
- The widget calls `submitFeedback` with positional args (not a form action), which is why it isn't a `useActionState` form — intentional and self-contained.
- Notification fan-out targets `role: "ADMIN"` only (consistent with the existing ticket flow); SUPPORT-role staff won't get the notification but can still see everything on the admin page.
- No schema/build/generate/restart run, no new deps, no commits — as required.
